summary: Iterate: Finish the live-thread Steel Browser repair. Fix the discovered CLI bug where URL-only runs incorrectly honor a Jev project preference and fail preflight; URL-only navigation must always use project-scoped Playwright without paid-model authorization, while goal-based runs keep existing engine policy and no-replay safety. Rebuild, reload, run the fixed CLI in this exact thread, verify the active page through CDP, and re-emit the inline browser directive. Preserve BB Connect authentication requirements; improve sign-in/reload guidance only if needed, without bypassing authentication.

Keep the root orchestration-only conventions, align manifest/package/CLI/UI/docs/tests, avoid committing generated artifacts, and verify the Steel service plus the plugin's human UI and CLI surface.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Fix the Steel Browser Tools settings panel so it never sends undefined projectId values over RPC. When no BB project context is available, render a clear project-unavailable state instead of calling project RPC, while keeping Jev host configuration visible. Add focused coverage, rebuild, reload, and update the existing draft PR.

sizeDecision.reason: This is a narrow correction to the existing Steel Browser Tools surface and must ship with the same plugin capability; splitting would leave the known settings error unresolved.
